
FILE scripts/step28_positive_ranking_verify.py
    1 """Bounded dual positive-rank CPU/native qualification; no formal data."""
    2 from __future__ import annotations
    3 from step28_g_half_verify import STARTED, state, restore, component_effects, checked_fresh, disk_reserve, native_save
    4 import argparse
    5 import gc
    6 import math
    7 import os
    8 import shutil
    9 import subprocess
   10 from pathlib import Path
   11 import sys
   12 import threading
   13 import time
   14 import traceback
   15 import unittest

   17 import psutil
   18 import torch
   19 import step28_positive_ranking_run as run
   20 from step28_record_replay_verify import preflight
   21 from step28_record_replay_numerics import equal_state
   22 method,record,diag,core,data=run.method,run.record,run.diag,run.core,run.data

   25 def native_preflight(continuing: bool = False) -> dict:
   26     if not continuing:
   27         return preflight()
   28     # The completed first arm leaves a CUDA context, but no live model/state may survive.
   29     gc.collect()
   30     torch.cuda.synchronize()
   31     torch.cuda.empty_cache()
   32     if torch.cuda.memory_allocated() or torch.cuda.memory_reserved():
   33         raise ValueError("Previous arm still owns live/reserved CUDA tensors")
   34     process = psutil.Process()
   35     if (os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "0" or len(process.cpu_affinity()) != 1
   36             or any(os.environ.get(k) != "1" for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"))
   37             or os.environ.get("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM") != "false"):
   38         raise ValueError("Physical GPU0 and pre-import single-thread environment required")
   39     gpu = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--id=0", "--query-gpu=index,uuid,memory.total,memory.free,memory.used",
   40                                    "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], text=True).strip()
   41     apps = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--id=0", "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory",
   42                                     "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], text=True).strip()
   43     foreign_apps = [line for line in apps.splitlines() if int(line.split(",", 1)[0].strip()) != process.pid]
   44     ancestors = {process.pid, *(p.pid for p in process.parents())}
   45     jobs = [p.info for p in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "username", "cmdline"])
   46             if p.pid not in ancestors and any("step28" in x for x in (p.info["cmdline"] or []))]
   47     available = psutil.virtual_memory().available
   48     if int(gpu.split(",")[-2]) < 30*1024 or available < 72*2**30 or foreign_apps or jobs:
   49         raise ValueError(f"Continuation resource gate failed: gpu={gpu}, apps={apps}, host={available}, jobs={jobs}")
   50     return {"gpu": gpu, "compute_apps": apps, "host_available_bytes": available, "project_jobs": jobs,
   51             "allowed_context_pid": process.pid, "live_allocated_bytes": 0, "reserved_bytes": 0}
   52 
   53 
   54 def native(check, progress, handwritten, out, arm, *, continuing=False):
   55     method = run.method
   56     active, control = arm, arm+"_old_rank"
   57     resources = native_preflight(continuing)
   58     if shutil.disk_usage(out).free < 10*2**30:
   59         raise ValueError("Insufficient native temporary disk")
   60     numerics = run.parent.configure_numerics()
   61     torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(28*2**30/torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory,0)
   62     measurements, updates = {}, []
   63     def timed(name, fn):
   64         check(); torch.cuda.synchronize(); started = time.monotonic()
   65         value = fn(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
   66         measurements[name] = max(measurements.get(name,0.),time.monotonic()-started)
   67         return value
   68     c = run.config()
   69     c["handwritten_qualification"] = True
   70     model, optimizer, initial, archive = timed("L", lambda: checked_fresh(c))
   71     if not model.encoder[0].auto_model.is_gradient_checkpointing or not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported():
   72         raise ValueError("BF16/checkpointing required")
   73     if initial != {"model": "13b535e1d66a0f13f0d87461835bd3ba0cee69c531307884b471f8702bd14e4b",
   74             "adam": "de5b1864dc195dd65286e083567e3fd8bb6a146a9ecfcc3bae6b3fdda8c32d20"}:
   75         raise ValueError("positive-rank native initial identity differs")
   76     method.bind(model, method.metadata(active))
   77     current, history = [handwritten.handmade_group("native_"+s,8,254) for s in ("current","history")]
   78     for g in (current,history):
   79         lengths = [len(v) for v in model.encoder.tokenizer(run.base.record_texts(g,"separate_moments"),padding=False,truncation=False)["input_ids"]]
   80         if len(lengths)!=448 or set(lengths)!={256}:
   81             raise ValueError("Maximum N224/token256 fixture differs")
   82     probes = {"encoder":model.encoder[0].auto_model.encoder.layer[0].attention.self.query.weight,"head":model.head[0].weight}
   83     gradients, effects, table_checks, objective_pairs = {}, {}, [], {}
   84     def updated(arm, phase, step, h=None, target=None):
   85         if len(updates)>=6: raise ValueError("Six actual native calls exhausted")
   86         pre = {}
   87         def observe(role, log):
   88             pre[role] = {}
   89             for key,p in probes.items():
   90                 if p.grad is None or not torch.isfinite(p.grad).all(): raise ValueError("Missing native gradient")
   91                 pre[role][key] = p.grad.detach().cpu().clone()
   92         captured = []
   93         options = dict(qualification_old_rank=arm == control,
   94             table_observer=(lambda table, group, seed, reference: captured.append((table.clone(), group, seed, reference))) if arm == active else None)
   95         progress("native_call_started", attempted_calls=len(updates)+1, actual_updates=len(updates))
   96         row = timed(("t_"+phase) if arm == active else "control_"+phase,
   97             lambda: method.update(model,optimizer,current,h,target,c,active,
   98                                   1 if h is None else 2,step,check,observe,**options))
   99         updates.append(dict(arm=arm,phase=phase,step=step,log=row))
  100         gradients[len(updates)] = pre
  101         progress("native_update",actual_updates=len(updates),updates=updates,measurements=measurements)
  102         for table, group, seed, reference in captured:
  103             table_checks.append(handwritten.verify_native_table(table, group, seed, reference, active))
  104             progress("native_table_precision", table_precision=table_checks)
  105         return row
  106     # The only actual allocation update. Subsequent fixture clocks are explicit, not claimed training.
  107     updated(control,"allocation",1)
  108     work=out/"work";work.mkdir(); identities={}
  109     def metadata(label):
  110         return dict(fixture=label,**method.metadata(active),rng=diag.rng_state(),modes=[m.training for m in model.modules()])
  111     common_path=work/"common.pt";common_meta=metadata("One actual "+control+" update; common current fixture Adam step1")
  112     common = timed("s_F",lambda:native_save(common_path,model,optimizer,common_meta,check))
  113     identities["common"] = common
  114     def reload(path,receipt):
  115         return timed("r_F",lambda:run.restore_point(path,receipt,model,optimizer,active))
  116     reload(common_path,common); updated(control,"A",2); gcurrent=state(model,optimizer)
  117     reload(common_path,common); hrow=updated(active,"A",2)
  118     effects["current"] = component_effects(model,gcurrent,optimizer=optimizer)
  119     for key in probes:
  120         delta=float((gradients[2]["current"][key]-gradients[3]["current"][key]).abs().max())
  121         if delta<=0:raise ValueError("Candidate-control preclip current gradient not distinguishable")
  122         effects["current"][key]["pre_clip_gradient_max_delta"]=delta
  123     progress("native_effects", effects=effects)
  124     objective_pairs["current"] = run.native_objective_pair(updates[1]["log"], hrow, 1)
  125     progress("native_objective_pair", objective_pairs=objective_pairs)
  126     del gcurrent;gc.collect()
  127     reload(common_path,common)
  128     # Same trained-one-step parameters/moments, but legal B epoch1 counter336 for the paired fixture.
  129     for value in optimizer.state.values(): value["step"].fill_(336)
  130     with diag.neutral(model):table=timed("v",lambda:record.reference(model,history,c,check))
  131     i,j=np.triu_indices(224,1);target=(table+2*np.sin(i*.31+j*.71)).astype(np.float32)
  132     paired_path=work/"paired.pt";paired_meta=metadata("Synthetic Adam step336; parameters/moments from one real "+control+" allocation update")
  133     paired=timed("s_F",lambda:native_save(paired_path,model,optimizer,paired_meta,check));identities["paired"]=paired
  134     reload(paired_path,paired);updated(control,"B",49,history,target);gpaired=state(model,optimizer)
  135     reload(paired_path,paired);first=updated(active,"B",49,history,target)
  136     if first["history"]["mse0"]<=0 or first["history"]["supervised"]<=0:raise ValueError("Inactive D/history")
  137     effects["paired"]=component_effects(model,gpaired,optimizer=optimizer)
  138     for key in probes:
  139         delta=float((gradients[4]["history"][key]-gradients[5]["history"][key]).abs().max())
  140         if delta<=0:raise ValueError("Candidate-control preclip paired gradient not distinguishable")
  141         effects["paired"][key]["pre_clip_gradient_max_delta"]=delta
  142         branch_deltas = {}
  143         for role in ("current", "history"):
  144             off = gradients[4][role][key]-(gradients[4]["current"][key] if role == "history" else 0)
  145             on = gradients[5][role][key]-(gradients[5]["current"][key] if role == "history" else 0)
  146             branch_deltas[role] = float((off-on).abs().max())
  147             if branch_deltas[role] <= 0:
  148                 raise ValueError("Missing isolated native rank effect: "+role+"/"+key)
  149         effects["paired"][key]["isolated_branch_preclip_deltas"] = branch_deltas
  150     progress("native_effects", effects=effects)
  151     objective_pairs["paired"] = run.native_objective_pair(updates[3]["log"], first, 2)
  152     progress("native_objective_pair", objective_pairs=objective_pairs)
  153     del gpaired;gc.collect()
  154     expected, expected_rng = state(model,optimizer), diag.rng_state()
  155     reload(paired_path,paired)
  156     memory=handwritten.shared_memory(active);memory.begin_stage(2)
  157     for _ in range(48):memory.draw()
  158     payload=memory.to_bytes();rng=diag.rng_state();modes=[m.training for m in model.modules()]
  159     fit=[handwritten.handmade_group(f"native_fit_{i}") for i in range(48)]
  160     valid=[data.Group(g.uid,g.sellers,g.items) for g in [handwritten.handmade_group(f"native_valid_{i}") for i in range(40)]]
  161     before=core.state_digest(state(model,optimizer));droot=out/"diagnostics";droot.mkdir()
  162     progress("actual_candidate_full_role_capture", actual_updates=len(updates))
  163     method.capture(model,optimizer,fit,memory,valid,c,active,2,1,droot,"handwritten",check)
  164     if before!=core.state_digest(state(model,optimizer)) or rng!=diag.rng_state() or payload!=memory.to_bytes():
  165         raise ValueError("Actual candidate capture mutated state")
  166     repeated=updated(active,"B",49,history,target)
  167     equality={"tensors":0,"elements":0};equal_state(expected,state(model,optimizer),equality)
  168     if expected_rng!=diag.rng_state() or payload!=memory.to_bytes() or modes!=[m.training for m in model.modules()] or first!=repeated:
  169         raise ValueError("Capture changed repeated next update")
  170     del expected;gc.collect()
  171     if len(updates)!=6 or run.parent.adam_step(optimizer)!=337:raise ValueError("Native call accounting differs")
  172     def residual():
  173         errors=[]
  174         for seed in (None,data.seed_for(20261008,"ABC",2,history.uid,"diagnostic_regroup")):
  175             slots=record.assignment(history,seed)
  176             errors.append((method.account_logits(torch.from_numpy(table),slots,active)-
  177                            method.account_logits(torch.from_numpy(target),slots,active)).numpy().astype(np.float64))
  178         return dict(D0=float(np.mean(errors[0]**2)),D1=float(np.mean(errors[1]**2)))
  179     residuals=timed("h",residual)
  180     # Persist the actual candidate-updated state, releasing the obsolete common work file first.
  181     data.write_json(out/"temporary_checkpoint_identity.json",dict(files=identities,removed=False))
  182     common_path.unlink()
  183     actual_meta=metadata("After actual candidate update6; H full-state restore")
  184     actual=timed("s_F",lambda:native_save(common_path,model,optimizer,actual_meta,check))
  185     identities["H_full"]=actual
  186     with diag.neutral(model):
  187         timed("v",lambda:record.reference(model,history,c,check))
  188         before_scores=timed("v",lambda:method.restored_score(model,[history],c,check))
  189     if reload(common_path,actual)!=actual_meta:raise ValueError("Full H metadata restore mismatch")
  190     with diag.neutral(model):
  191         if not np.array_equal(before_scores,timed("v",lambda:method.restored_score(model,[history],c,check))):
  192             raise ValueError("Full H scores not bitwise restored")
  193     inference_path=work/"H_inference.pt";infer_meta=metadata("Actual candidate inference restore fixture")
  194     infer=timed("s_I",lambda:native_save(inference_path,model,None,infer_meta,check));identities["inference"]=infer
  195     if timed("r_I",lambda:run.restore_point(inference_path,infer,model,None,active))!=infer_meta:
  196         raise ValueError("Inference H metadata restore mismatch")
  197     with diag.neutral(model):
  198         if not np.array_equal(before_scores,timed("v",lambda:method.restored_score(model,[history],c,check))):
  199             raise ValueError("Inference H scores not bitwise restored")
  200     measurements["W_F"]=max(common_path.stat().st_size,paired_path.stat().st_size)
  201     measurements["W_I"]=inference_path.stat().st_size
  202     data.write_json(out/"temporary_checkpoint_identity.json",dict(files=identities,removed=False))
  203     for path in (common_path,paired_path,inference_path):path.unlink()
  204     work.rmdir();data.write_json(out/"temporary_checkpoint_identity.json",dict(files=identities,removed=True))
  205     return dict(resources=resources,numerics=numerics,pretrained_archive=archive,initial_state=initial,
  206         actual_updates=6,updates=updates,measurements=measurements,projection=run.single.projection(measurements),effects=effects,
  207         both_phases_encoder_head_effect=True,pooling_restores_verified=True,next_update_bitwise_equal=True,
  208         metadata=method.metadata(active), rank_precision_verified=bool(table_checks),
  209         table_precision=table_checks, objective_pairs=objective_pairs,
  210         equality_counts=equality,maximum_records=224,channel_tokens=256,memory_bytes=len(payload),residuals=residuals,
  211         fixture="Six actual updates only. Common model/moments after call1; paired counter336 explicitly synthetic. Calls5/6 differ only by actual capture. No formal input.")
  212 
  213 def main():
  214     import importlib
  215     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
  216     parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("cpu", "gpu"))
  217     parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
  218     parser.add_argument("--gate", type=Path)
  219     parser.add_argument("--tests", nargs="*")
  220     parser.add_argument("--prior-seconds", type=float, default=0.)
  221     args = parser.parse_args()
  222     args.output = args.output.resolve()
  223     if os.name != "posix" or args.output.exists() or args.prior_seconds < 0:
  224         parser.error("Linux, new evidence and cumulative ledger required; GPU has no automatic retry")
  225     args.output.mkdir(parents=True)
  226     sys.path.insert(0, str(data.ROOT/"tests"))
  227     handwritten = importlib.import_module("test_step28_positive_ranking")
  228     os.environ["G_HALF_TEST_ROOT"] = str(args.output)
  229     os.environ["H_CONS_TEST_ROOT"] = str(args.output)
  230     torch.set_num_threads(1)
  231     torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
  232     numerics = run.parent.configure_numerics()
  233     process = psutil.Process()
  234     limits = run.policy()["cpu_verification" if args.mode == "cpu" else "native_verification"]
  235     report = {"status": "RUNNING", "mode": args.mode, "scope": "S_pos_H_pos_increment", "source_files": run.sources(), "formal_inputs": False, "torch": torch.__version__,
  236         "formal_labels": False, "prior_compute_seconds": args.prior_seconds, "peak_rss_bytes": 0, "peak_work_bytes": 0, "numerics": numerics}
  237     stopped, lock = threading.Event(), threading.RLock()
  238     arm_started = None
  239     def write():
  240         with lock:
  241             report["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic()-STARTED
  242             report["cumulative_seconds"] = args.prior_seconds+report["elapsed_seconds"]
  243             report["cumulative_charged_seconds"] = args.prior_seconds+math.ceil(report["elapsed_seconds"])
  244             if "prior_actual_updates" in report:
  245                 report["cumulative_actual_updates"] = report["prior_actual_updates"]+report.get("actual_updates", 0)
  246             if args.mode == "gpu" and torch.cuda.is_initialized():
  247                 report["max_reserved_bytes"] = torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()
  248             data.write_json(args.output/"result.json", report)
  249     def check(reserve=0):
  250         report["peak_rss_bytes"] = max(report["peak_rss_bytes"], process.memory_info().rss)
  251         total, evidence = 0, 0
  252         for path in args.output.parent.rglob("*"):
  253             try:
  254                 if path.is_file():
  255                     size = path.stat().st_size
  256                     total += size
  257                     if "work" not in path.relative_to(args.output.parent).parts:
  258                         evidence += size
  259             except FileNotFoundError:
  260                 pass
  261         report["peak_work_bytes"] = max(report["peak_work_bytes"], total)
  262         disk_reserve(args.output, total, reserve, limits.get("maximum_work_bytes", limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"]))
  263         if (time.monotonic()-STARTED+args.prior_seconds > limits["maximum_seconds"]
  264                 or (arm_started is not None and time.monotonic()-arm_started > limits["per_arm_maximum_seconds"])
  265                 or evidence > limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"] or total > limits.get("maximum_work_bytes", limits["maximum_evidence_bytes"])
  266                 or report["peak_rss_bytes"] > limits["maximum_rss_bytes"]
  267                 or (args.mode == "gpu" and torch.cuda.is_initialized() and torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved() > 28*2**30)):
  268             raise RuntimeError("Approved cumulative qualification budget exceeded")
  269     def watchdog():
  270         while not stopped.wait(.5):
  271             try:
  272                 check()
  273             except BaseException as exc:
  274                 report.update(status="BUDGET_STOP", error=str(exc))
  275                 write()
  276                 os._exit(2)
  277     def progress(stage, **details):
  278         report.update(stage=stage, **details)
  279         write()
  280     watcher = threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True)
  281     watcher.start()
  282     try:
  283         if (len(process.cpu_affinity()) != 1 or any(os.environ.get(k) != "1" for k in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"))
  284                 or os.environ.get("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM") != "false"):
  285             raise ValueError("Pre-import single CPU/thread environment required")
  286         if args.prior_seconds < limits["prior_charged_seconds"]:
  287             raise ValueError("Prior charged budget cannot be reset")
  288         if args.mode == "cpu":
  289             if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "":
  290                 raise ValueError("CPU qualification must disable GPU")
  291             test_class = handwritten.PositiveRankingTests
  292             selected = args.tests or unittest.defaultTestLoader.getTestCaseNames(test_class)
  293             report["selected_tests"] = selected
  294             suite = unittest.TestSuite(test_class(name) for name in selected)
  295             with (args.output/"unittest.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
  296                 result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2, failfast=True).run(suite)
  297             report.update(tests_run=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped))
  298             if not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped:
  299                 raise RuntimeError("Affected handwritten qualification failed")
  300         else:
  301             if args.gate is None:
  302                 raise ValueError("Implementation review gate required")
  303             gate = run.reviewed_gate(args.gate, "NATIVE")
  304             if args.prior_seconds != 0:
  305                 raise ValueError("Unique dual native attempt; no automatic retry")
  306             report["arms"] = {}
  307             for arm in method.ARMS:
  308                 arm_started = time.monotonic()
  309                 arm_out = args.output/arm
  310                 arm_out.mkdir()
  311                 def arm_check(reserve=0):
  312                     check(reserve)
  313                     if time.monotonic()-arm_started > limits["per_arm_maximum_seconds"]:
  314                         raise RuntimeError("Per-arm native budget exceeded")
  315                 def arm_progress(stage, **details):
  316                     if "actual_updates" in details:
  317                         details["active_arm_actual_updates"] = details["actual_updates"]
  318                         details["actual_updates"] += sum(v["actual_updates"] for v in report["arms"].values())
  319                     progress(stage, active_arm=arm, **details)
  320                 value = native(arm_check, arm_progress, handwritten, arm_out, arm,
  321                                continuing=bool(report["arms"]))
  322                 arm_check()
  323                 value["charged_seconds"] = math.ceil(time.monotonic()-arm_started)
  324                 report["arms"][arm] = value
  325                 arm_started = None
  326                 write()
  327             report["actual_updates"] = sum(v["actual_updates"] for v in report["arms"].values())
  328         check()
  329         report["status"] = "PASS_HANDWRITTEN_ONLY"
  330         if args.mode == "cpu":
  331             report.update(qualified_tests=selected, unresolved_checks=[])
  332     except BaseException as exc:
  333         report.update(status="FAIL", traceback=traceback.format_exc())
  334         raise
  335     finally:
  336         stopped.set()
  337         watcher.join(timeout=2)
  338         write()
  339 
  340 if __name__ == "__main__":
  341     main()
